Trends 2026–2027

Where AI digital marketing is heading

The playbook is changing fast. These are the shifts I'm building for — so a brand can get ahead before its competitors even notice.

AI-Generated & AI-Edited Video

Short-form video still wins attention, and AI now lets small teams ship studio-style ads, explainers, and festive campaigns in hours. More creative, tested faster, wins. I already work this way.

AI VideoReelsShorts

Search Is Going Generative

People now get answers from AI search and overviews, not just links. Content must be structured, credible, and quotable to get cited — SEO plus Generative Engine Optimization.

GEOSEOAI Search

Hyper-Personalization at Scale

AI tailors messages, creatives, and offers to each viewer's intent — moving from one campaign for everyone to the right message for each person.

PersonalizationSegmentation

AI Agents & Automation

Agents that draft, schedule, report, and respond are absorbing repetitive work, freeing marketers to focus on strategy, creativity, and brand judgment.

AutomationWorkflows

Social Search & Community-First

Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok are becoming search engines. Authentic, creator-style content and real community beat polished but generic ads.

Social SearchUGCCommunity

Privacy-First, First-Party Data

With cookies fading, brands win on owned audiences and clean analytics — measured with Google Analytics and read with a human eye.

First-Party DataAnalytics
The common thread: AI raises the floor for everyone — taste, strategy, and storytelling raise the ceiling. That is the gap I'm here to fill.
